item.title: The privacy nightmare of browser fingerprinting
item.description:
📝 Browser fingerprinting does not depend on cookies. Canvas fingerprinting works by having the browser run code that draws text (perhaps invisibly), and then retrieving the individual pixel data that it drew. It appears that only about one browser in every thousand share the same canvas fingerprint.
🔗 Read more: https://kevinboone.me/fingerprinting.html

item.title: New Apple Study Shows LLMs Can Tell What You're Doing from Audio and Motion Data
item.description:
📝 Apple Research New Apple study shows LLMs can tell what you’re doing from audio and motion data Marcus Mendes | Nov 21 2025 - 1:56 pm PT 3 Comments Apple researchers have published a study that looks into how LLMs can analyze audio and motion data to get a better overview of the user’s activities. We show that large language models (LLMs) can be used for late fusion for activity classification from audio and motion time series data. , household activities, sports) from the Ego4D dataset.
🔗 Read more: https://9to5mac.com/2025/11/21/apple-research-llm-study-audio-motion-activity/
